images.caption: View from the Friedensbrücke to the town Bautzen in Saxony, Germany. In the foreground the so-called Hexenhäuschen (before 1604). In the centre the Mönchsbastei (1324) on Mühltorgasse. In the background (from left) the water tower (1877) in the ruins of the monk's church, the Dom St. Petri (1213/1221) and the Town Hall Bautzen (1213/1705).
images.alt: View from the Friedensbrücke to the town Bautzen in Saxony, Germany. In the foreground the so-called Hexenhäuschen (before 1604). In the centre the Mönchsbastei (1324) on Mühltorgasse. In the background (from left) the water tower (1877) in the ruins of the monk's church, the Dom St. Petri (1213/1221) and the Town Hall Bautzen (1213/1705).
